description: Search lodging listings, optionally filtered by location, date range, guest count, and price bounds.

location.description: Optional location substring matched against a listing's city or country.

checkin.description: Optional check-in date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format; combined with checkout to filter by availability.

checkout.description: Optional check-out date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format; combined with checkin to filter by availability.

guests.description: Optional minimum guest capacity; only listings with max_guests at least this are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with count and a list of matching listings (each with attached host).

description: Get a single listing by its id, including host details.

listing_id.description: The unique id of the listing.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the listing object with attached host; on failure (listing not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the availability windows for a listing.

listing_id.description: The unique id of the listing.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with listing_id and a list of availability windows; on failure (listing not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the reviews for a listing.

listing_id.description: The unique id of the listing.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with listing_id, count, and a list of reviews; on failure (listing not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a reservation for a listing over a date range, computing nightly subtotal, fees, and total.

listing_id.description: The unique id of the listing to reserve.

checkout.description: Check-out date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format; must be after checkin.

guests.description: Number of guests (default 1); must not exceed the listing's max_guests.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created reservation with pricing breakdown; on failure (not found, invalid dates, over capacity, or unavailable), output contains an error message.

description: Get a reservation by its id.

reservation_id.description: The unique id of the reservation.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the reservation object; on failure (reservation not found), output contains an error message.

description: Cancel an existing reservation by its id.

reservation_id.description: The unique id of the reservation to cancel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the cancelled reservation; on failure (not found or already cancelled), output contains an error message.
